self_assessment.original_prose:
All 20 obligations are formalized. `lake build` succeeds with no errors or warnings, and the files contain no `sorry`, `admit` or new axioms. `#print axioms` on every main declaration shows only `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound` (some use only `propext` and `Quot.sound`).

To build, I added two library entries (`LCH02` and `Main`) and a `defaultTargets` line to `lakefile.toml`. The original `require` and `formal_oet` entries are unchanged, and I did not touch `formal_oet/`.

Three representation choices to know about:
- **General distance family:** the definitions and theorems take any finite family `d : I → X → X → ENNReal`. None of the results need the pseudo-metric axioms or a nonempty `I`, so they apply to every gauge space as a special case.
- **Domain conditions inside the predicates:** the restricted Lip predicate includes `U ⊆ dom ϕ`. The co-Lip predicate includes both `U.Nonempty` and `U ⊆ dom ϕ`.
- **Index shift:** step m (1-based) is `Fin` index m−1. A product of n ≥ 1 matrices is written as n = N+1, and the intermediate index sequence is `Fin N → I`.

extra_assertion_review.scope: Entire original delivered prose, code comments, mathematical side claims and self-assessment, separately from kernel success.

obligations.title: 全域/受限Lip矩阵谓词与证书族
obligations.reason: Global and restricted certificate families use the required all-pair/all-output inequalities and explicit subset-domain condition, with equality at dom proved.
obligations.candidate_representation: 对象：规范族 {d_i}_{i∈I} 为 d : I → X → X → ENNReal（[Fintype I]）；算子 ϕ ∈ 𝒳_op 为前置 Operator X bot；非负扩展矩阵 L 为 Matrix I I ENNReal（条目取值 [0,+∞]，0·∞=0 由 ENNReal 算术给出）。IsLipMatrix d ϕ L：∀ x ∈ dom ϕ, ∀ y ∈ dom ϕ, ∀ j, d j (ϕ x)(ϕ y) ≤ ∑ i, L_{i→j} · d i x y；lipSet d ϕ = 𝓛(ϕ)。受限：IsLipMatrixOn d ϕ U L 把原文的前置条件 U ⊆ dom ϕ 作为合取项，再加上对 x,y ∈ U 的同一不等式；lipSetOn d ϕ U = 𝓛(ϕ)|_U。lipSet_eq_lipSetOn_dom 证明 𝓛(ϕ) = 𝓛(ϕ)|_{dom ϕ}。证书族是集合（Set），不预设存在极值矩阵。定义对任意距离族成立，因此特别适用于扩展规范空间。

declarations.name: LCH02.IsLipMatrix
declarations.source_excerpt:
def IsLipMatrix (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (L : Matrix I I ENNReal) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ dom ϕ, ∀ y ∈ dom ϕ, ∀ j : I,
    d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ ∑ i, arrowEntry L i j * d i x y

declarations.name: LCH02.lipSet
declarations.source_excerpt:
def lipSet (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) : Set (Matrix I I ENNReal) :=
  {L | IsLipMatrix d ϕ L}

declarations.name: LCH02.IsLipMatrixOn
declarations.source_excerpt:
def IsLipMatrixOn (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (L : Matrix I I ENNReal) : Prop :=
  U ⊆ dom ϕ ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
    d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ ∑ i, arrowEntry L i j * d i x y

declarations.name: LCH02.lipSetOn
LCH02.lipSet_eq_lipSetOn_dom
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem lipSet_eq_lipSetOn_dom (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) :
    lipSet d ϕ = lipSetOn d ϕ (dom ϕ) := by
  ext L
  exact ⟨fun h => ⟨subset_rfl, h⟩, fun h => h.2⟩

obligations.title: 含非空条件的受限co-Lip矩阵及证书族
obligations.reason: Restricted co-Lip membership explicitly includes a nonempty evaluation domain and the complete lower inequalities.
obligations.candidate_representation: IsCoLipMatrixOn d ϕ U K := U.Nonempty ∧ U ⊆ dom ϕ ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j, ∑ i, K_{i→j} · d i x y ≤ d j (ϕ x)(ϕ y)。原文的非空条件 U ≠ ∅ 和 U ⊆ dom ϕ 都写进了谓词。coLipSetOn d ϕ U = 𝒦(ϕ)|_U（下界证书族，不预设极值矩阵）。nonempty_of_mem_coLipSetOn 说明凡出现 𝒦(ϕ)|_U 的成员，U 必非空。

declarations.name: LCH02.IsCoLipMatrixOn
declarations.source_excerpt:
def IsCoLipMatrixOn (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (K : Matrix I I ENNReal) : Prop :=
  U.Nonempty ∧ U ⊆ dom ϕ ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
    ∑ i, arrowEntry K i j * d i x y ≤ d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y)

declarations.name: LCH02.coLipSetOn
LCH02.nonempty_of_mem_coLipSetOn

obligations.title: 输入/输出矩阵指标约定与乘法
obligations.reason: arrowEntry M i j=M j i and arrowEntry_mul has the required output-row convention and reversed application order.
obligations.candidate_representation: arrowEntry M i j := M j i，即 L_{i→j} 位于第 j 行（输出分量）、第 i 列（输入分量），对应 (L)_{ji} = L_{i→j}。矩阵乘法用 Mathlib 的 Matrix 乘法；arrowEntry_mul：(A·B)_{i→j} = ∑_k A_{k→j} B_{i→k}，与原文的 (L^{(2)}·L^{(1)})_{i→j} = ∑_k L^{(2)}_{k→j} L^{(1)}_{i→k} 一致。arrowEntry_fin_three 在 I = Fin 3（对应 {1,2,3}，指标平移 1）上验证原文 3×3 示例的行列布局，例如 L_{2→1} 位于第一行第二列。

declarations.name: LCH02.arrowEntry
declarations.source_excerpt: def arrowEntry (M : Matrix I I ENNReal) (i j : I) : ENNReal := M j i

declarations.name: LCH02.matrix_apply_eq_arrowEntry
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem matrix_apply_eq_arrowEntry (M : Matrix I I ENNReal) (i j : I) :
    M j i = arrowEntry M i j := rfl

declarations.name: LCH02.arrowEntry_mul
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem arrowEntry_mul [Fintype I] (A B : Matrix I I ENNReal) (i j : I) :
    arrowEntry (A * B) i j = ∑ k, arrowEntry A k j * arrowEntry B i k := by
  simp [arrowEntry, Matrix.mul_apply]

declarations.name: LCH02.arrowEntry_fin_three
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem arrowEntry_fin_three (a₁₁ a₂₁ a₃₁ a₁₂ a₂₂ a₃₂ a₁₃ a₂₃ a₃₃ : ENNReal) :
    let L : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ENNReal :=
      !![a₁₁, a₂₁, a₃₁; a₁₂, a₂₂, a₃₂; a₁₃, a₂₃, a₃₃]
    arrowEntry L 1 0 = a₂₁ ∧ arrowEntry L 0 1 = a₁₂ ∧ arrowEntry L 2 0 = a₃₁ ∧
      arrowEntry L 0 2 = a₁₃ := by
  simp [arrowEntry]

obligations.title: 单位矩阵、空乘积及有序非空乘积
obligations.reason: The recursive product left-multiplies the last factor; empty and singleton products and reversed-list correspondence are proved.
obligations.candidate_representation: 单位矩阵为 (1 : Matrix I I ENNReal)，arrowEntry_one 给出 𝐈_{i→j} = [i=j]。有序乘积 finOrderedProd 定义在任意幺半群上：对 M : Fin n → α，finOrderedProd M = M^{(n)}·⋯·M^{(1)}，其中 M^{(m)} = M (m−1)。n = 0 时为空乘积 1（finOrderedProd_zero；矩阵情形见 finOrderedProd_matrix_zero，即空乘积 = 𝐈）。非空乘积按 M^{(n+1)}·(M^{(n)}⋯M^{(1)}) 递推（finOrderedProd_succ），也有另一侧递推（finOrderedProd_succ'）；单项乘积为 M^{(1)}（finOrderedProd_one）。finOrderedProd_eq_list_prod 证明它等于列表 [M^{(n)},…,M^{(1)}] 的乘积。

declarations.name: LCH02.arrowEntry_one
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem arrowEntry_one [DecidableEq I] (i j : I) :
    arrowEntry (1 : Matrix I I ENNReal) i j = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h
    simp [arrowEntry]
  · simp [arrowEntry, h, Matrix.one_apply_ne (Ne.symm h)]

declarations.name: LCH02.sum_arrowEntry_one_mul
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem sum_arrowEntry_one_mul [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (f : I → ENNReal) (j : I) :
    ∑ i, arrowEntry (1 : Matrix I I ENNReal) i j * f i = f j := by
  simp [arrowEntry_one, ite_mul]

declarations.name: LCH02.finOrderedProd
declarations.source_excerpt:
def finOrderedProd : {n : ℕ} → (Fin n → α) → α
  | 0, _ => 1
  | n + 1, M => M (Fin.last n) * finOrderedProd (fun m : Fin n => M m.castSucc)

declarations.name: LCH02.finOrderedProd_zero
declarations.source_excerpt: theorem finOrderedProd_zero (M : Fin 0 → α) : finOrderedProd M = 1 := rfl

declarations.name: LCH02.finOrderedProd_succ
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem finOrderedProd_succ {n : ℕ} (M : Fin (n + 1) → α) :
    finOrderedProd M = M (Fin.last n) * finOrderedProd (fun m : Fin n => M m.castSucc) := rfl

declarations.name: LCH02.finOrderedProd_one
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem finOrderedProd_one (M : Fin 1 → α) : finOrderedProd M = M 0 := by
  simp [finOrderedProd_succ]

declarations.name: LCH02.finOrderedProd_succ'
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem finOrderedProd_succ' {n : ℕ} (M : Fin (n + 1) → α) :
    finOrderedProd M = finOrderedProd (fun m : Fin n => M m.succ) * M 0 := by
  rw [finOrderedProd_eq_list_prod, finOrderedProd_eq_list_prod, List.ofFn_succ]
  simp

declarations.name: LCH02.finOrderedProd_eq_list_prod
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem finOrderedProd_eq_list_prod {n : ℕ} (M : Fin n → α) :
    finOrderedProd M = (List.ofFn M).reverse.prod := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [finOrderedProd_succ, ih, List.ofFn_succ', List.concat_eq_append, List.reverse_append]
    simp

declarations.name: LCH02.finOrderedProd_matrix_zero
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem finOrderedProd_matrix_zero {I : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (M : Fin 0 → Matrix I I ENNReal) : finOrderedProd M = 1 := rfl

obligations.title: 实际中间像域与链表示对应
obligations.reason: chainDomain is the actual recursively generated image, and partial/full image identities and every step-domain inclusion are proved from the composite-domain assumption.
obligations.candidate_representation: 链 ϕ_1,…,ϕ_k 表示为 ϕ : Fin k → Operator X bot（ϕ_m = ϕ (m−1)）。c_k = ϕ_k∘⋯∘ϕ_1 表示为算子幺半群中的 finOrderedProd ϕ：c_0 = id（finOrderedProd_operator_zero），c_{k+1} = ϕ_{k+1}∘c_k（finOrderedProd_operator_func_succ），并且它等于前置模块的 OperatorChain [ϕ_k,…,ϕ_1]（finOrderedProd_eq_operatorChain，经 operator_chain_eq_prod）。实际中间像域 chainDomain ϕ U₁ : Fin (k+1) → Set X 按原文递推定义：U_1 = U₁（chainDomain_zero），U_{m+1} = ϕ_m(U_m)（chainDomain_succ）；chainDomain ϕ U₁ m 表示 U_{m+1}，第 m 步的输入域为 chainDomain ϕ U₁ m.castSucc。另外证明：U_{m+1} = c_m(U₁)（chainDomain_eq_image_partial），U_{k+1} = c_k(U₁)（chainDomain_last），截去最后一步不改变前面的像域（chainDomain_init），以及由 U₁ ⊆ dom c_k 逐步推出 U_m ⊆ dom ϕ_m（chainDomain_subset_dom）。

declarations.name: LCH02.chainDomain
declarations.source_excerpt:
def chainDomain {k : ℕ} (ϕ : Fin k → Operator X bot) (U₁ : Set X) : Fin (k + 1) → Set X :=
  Fin.induction U₁ (fun m Um => operator_image (ϕ m) Um)

declarations.name: LCH02.chainDomain_zero
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem chainDomain_zero {k : ℕ} (ϕ : Fin k → Operator X bot) (U₁ : Set X) :
    chainDomain ϕ U₁ 0 = U₁ := by
  simp [chainDomain]

declarations.name: LCH02.chainDomain_succ
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem chainDomain_succ {k : ℕ} (ϕ : Fin k → Operator X bot) (U₁ : Set X) (m : Fin k) :
    chainDomain ϕ U₁ m.succ = operator_image (ϕ m) (chainDomain ϕ U₁ m.castSucc) := by
  simp [chainDomain]

declarations.name: LCH02.chainDomain_init
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem chainDomain_init {k : ℕ} (ϕ : Fin (k + 1) → Operator X bot) (U₁ : Set X)
    (m : Fin (k + 1)) :
    chainDomain (fun i : Fin k => ϕ i.castSucc) U₁ m = chainDomain ϕ U₁ m.castSucc := by
  induction m using Fin.induction with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [chainDomain_succ, ih, ← Fin.succ_castSucc, chainDomain_succ]

declarations.name: LCH02.chainDomain_last
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem chainDomain_last {k : ℕ} (ϕ : Fin k → Operator X bot) (U₁ : Set X) :
    chainDomain ϕ U₁ (Fin.last k) = operator_image (finOrderedProd ϕ) U₁ := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    show U₁ = id '' U₁
    rw [Set.image_id]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [← Fin.succ_last, chainDomain_succ, ← chainDomain_init, ih]
    simp only [operator_image, finOrderedProd_operator_func_succ, Set.image_comp]

declarations.name: LCH02.chainDomain_eq_image_partial
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem chainDomain_eq_image_partial {k : ℕ} (ϕ : Fin k → Operator X bot) (U₁ : Set X)
    (m : Fin (k + 1)) :
    chainDomain ϕ U₁ m =
      operator_image (finOrderedProd (fun i : Fin m => ϕ (Fin.castLE (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp m.isLt) i)))
        U₁ := by
  induction m using Fin.induction with
  | zero =>
    show U₁ = id '' U₁
    rw [Set.image_id]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [chainDomain_succ, ih]
    simp only [operator_image, Fin.val_succ, finOrderedProd_operator_func_succ, Set.image_comp]
    rfl

declarations.name: LCH02.chainDomain_subset_dom
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem chainDomain_subset_dom {k : ℕ} (ϕ : Fin k → Operator X bot) (U₁ : Set X)
    (hU₁ : U₁ ⊆ dom (finOrderedProd ϕ)) (m : Fin k) :
    chainDomain ϕ U₁ m.castSucc ⊆ dom (ϕ m) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact m.elim0
  | succ k ih =>
    have hinit : U₁ ⊆ dom (finOrderedProd (fun i : Fin k => ϕ i.castSucc)) :=
      hU₁.trans (dom_mul_subset_right _ _)
    induction m using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      rw [← chainDomain_init, chainDomain_last]
      exact image_subset_dom_of_subset_dom_mul hU₁
    | cast m =>
      rw [← chainDomain_init]
      exact ih (fun i => ϕ i.castSucc) hinit m

declarations.name: LCH02.finOrderedProd_operator_zero
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem finOrderedProd_operator_zero (ϕ : Fin 0 → Operator X bot) :
    finOrderedProd ϕ = operator_identity := rfl

declarations.name: LCH02.finOrderedProd_operator_func_succ
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem finOrderedProd_operator_func_succ {k : ℕ} (ϕ : Fin (k + 1) → Operator X bot) :
    (finOrderedProd ϕ).func =
      (ϕ (Fin.last k)).func ∘ (finOrderedProd (fun m : Fin k => ϕ m.castSucc)).func := rfl

declarations.name: LCH02.finOrderedProd_eq_operatorChain
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem finOrderedProd_eq_operatorChain {k : ℕ} (ϕ : Fin k → Operator X bot) :
    finOrderedProd ϕ = OperatorChain (List.ofFn ϕ).reverse := by
  rw [operator_chain_eq_prod, finOrderedProd_eq_list_prod]

declarations.name: LCH02.dom_mul_subset_right
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem dom_mul_subset_right (ϕ₂ ϕ₁ : Operator X bot) : dom (ϕ₂ * ϕ₁) ⊆ dom ϕ₁ := by
  intro x hx h
  apply hx
  change ϕ₂.func (ϕ₁.func x) = bot
  rw [h, ϕ₂.preserves_bot]

declarations.name: LCH02.image_subset_dom_of_subset_dom_mul
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem image_subset_dom_of_subset_dom_mul {ϕ₂ ϕ₁ : Operator X bot} {U₁ : Set X}
    (hU₁ : U₁ ⊆ dom (ϕ₂ * ϕ₁)) : operator_image ϕ₁ U₁ ⊆ dom ϕ₂ := by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact hU₁ hx

obligations.title: 有限指标路径与全正路径谓词
obligations.reason: indexPath enumerates all unconstrained intermediate sequences, proves uniqueness of the representation and its endpoints, and defines positive/zero factors without filtering paths.
obligations.candidate_representation: n ≥ 1 写作 n = N+1，矩阵族为 M : Fin (N+1) → Matrix I I ENNReal。中间指标序列 (k_1,…,k_{n−1}) 为 p : Fin N → I。indexPath i j p : Fin (N+2) → I 是完整路径 (k_0,…,k_n)，满足 k_0 = i、k_n = j、k_m = p(m−1)。existsUnique_indexPath 证明端点固定的完整路径与中间序列一一对应。pathFactor M i j p t = [M^{(t+1)}]_{k_t→k_{t+1}}。IsAllPositivePath：所有层级的因子 > 0；HasZeroFactor：存在某层因子 = 0。n = 1 时中间序列是唯一的空序列 Fin 0 → I，其因子为 [M^{(1)}]_{i→j}（pathFactor_one）。

declarations.name: LCH02.indexPath
declarations.source_excerpt:
def indexPath (i j : I) {N : ℕ} (p : Fin N → I) : Fin (N + 2) → I :=
  Fin.cons i (Fin.snoc p j)

declarations.name: LCH02.indexPath_zero
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem indexPath_zero (i j : I) {N : ℕ} (p : Fin N → I) : indexPath i j p 0 = i := by
  simp [indexPath]

declarations.name: LCH02.indexPath_last
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem indexPath_last (i j : I) {N : ℕ} (p : Fin N → I) :
    indexPath i j p (Fin.last (N + 1)) = j := by
  rw [← Fin.succ_last]
  simp [indexPath]

declarations.name: LCH02.indexPath_succ_castSucc
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem indexPath_succ_castSucc (i j : I) {N : ℕ} (p : Fin N → I) (m : Fin N) :
    indexPath i j p m.castSucc.succ = p m := by
  simp [indexPath]

declarations.name: LCH02.existsUnique_indexPath
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem existsUnique_indexPath (i j : I) {N : ℕ} (k : Fin (N + 2) → I) (hi : k 0 = i)
    (hj : k (Fin.last (N + 1)) = j) : ∃! p : Fin N → I, indexPath i j p = k := by
  refine ⟨fun m => k m.castSucc.succ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · funext t
    induction t using Fin.cases with
    | zero => simp [hi]
    | succ t =>
      induction t using Fin.lastCases with
      | last => rw [Fin.succ_last, indexPath_last, hj]
      | cast m => simp
  · intro p hp
    funext m
    rw [← hp, indexPath_succ_castSucc]

declarations.name: LCH02.pathFactor
LCH02.IsAllPositivePath
LCH02.HasZeroFactor
LCH02.pathFactor_one
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem pathFactor_one (M : Fin 1 → Matrix I I ENNReal) (i j : I) (p : Fin 0 → I) :
    pathFactor M i j p 0 = arrowEntry (M 0) i j := by
  simp only [pathFactor]
  rw [show (0 : Fin 1).succ = Fin.last 1 from rfl, indexPath_last, Fin.castSucc_zero,
    indexPath_zero]

obligations.title: 单分量求和退化为标量Lip界
obligations.reason: Singleton indexing collapses the whole finite sum and all-output condition to the original scalar inequality, in both global and restricted forms.
obligations.candidate_representation: |I| = 1 且 I = {i} 表示为前提 i : I 与 hI : ∀ k : I, k = i。结论为等价式：L ∈ 𝓛(ϕ) ↔ ∀ x,y ∈ dom ϕ, d_i(ϕx,ϕy) ≤ L_{i→i}·d_i(x,y)。另给受限版本 lipSetOn_single_component（U ⊆ dom ϕ 的合取项保留）。证明用 Finset.sum_eq_single 把求和退化为单项。

declarations.name: LCH02.lipSet_single_component
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem lipSet_single_component (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot)
    (i : I) (hI : ∀ k : I, k = i) (L : Matrix I I ENNReal) :
    L ∈ lipSet d ϕ ↔
      ∀ x ∈ dom ϕ, ∀ y ∈ dom ϕ,
        d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ arrowEntry L i i * d i x y := by
  rw [lipSet_eq_lipSetOn_dom, lipSetOn_single_component d ϕ (dom ϕ) i hI L]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨subset_rfl, h⟩⟩

declarations.name: LCH02.lipSetOn_single_component
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem lipSetOn_single_component (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (i : I) (hI : ∀ k : I, k = i) (L : Matrix I I ENNReal) :
    L ∈ lipSetOn d ϕ U ↔
      U ⊆ dom ϕ ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U,
        d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ arrowEntry L i i * d i x y := by
  have hsum : ∀ f : I → ENNReal, ∑ k, f k = f i := fun f => by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun k _ hk => absurd (hI k) hk) (fun h => absurd (mem_univ i) h)]
  simp only [lipSetOn, IsLipMatrixOn, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hsum]
  refine and_congr_right fun _ => ⟨fun h x hx y hy => h x hx y hy i, fun h x hx y hy j => ?_⟩
  rw [hI j]
  exact h x hx y hy

obligations.title: 受限Lip矩阵族反单调
obligations.reason: Restriction is proved by pairwise subset transport; no larger or altered domain is used.
obligations.candidate_representation: 前提 U ⊆ V（hUV）与 V ⊆ dom ϕ（hV），对应原文 U ⊆ V ⊆ dom(ϕ)；结论 lipSetOn d ϕ V ⊆ lipSetOn d ϕ U，即 𝓛(ϕ)|_V ⊆ 𝓛(ϕ)|_U，对任意 ϕ 与距离族成立。

declarations.name: LCH02.lipSetOn_antitone
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem lipSetOn_antitone (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) {U V : Set X}
    (hUV : U ⊆ V) (hV : V ⊆ dom ϕ) :
    lipSetOn d ϕ V ⊆ lipSetOn d ϕ U := by
  rintro L ⟨-, hL⟩
  exact ⟨hUV.trans hV, fun x hx y hy j => hL x (hUV hx) y (hUV hy) j⟩

obligations.title: 两步Lip复合：精确中间像域，乘积次序
obligations.reason: The outer certificate is applied on the exact inner image; substitution, monotone multiplication and exchange of finite sums produce L₂*L₁.
obligations.candidate_representation: 复合 ϕ₂∘ϕ₁ 为 ϕ₂ * ϕ₁（前置幺半群，func = ϕ₂.func ∘ ϕ₁.func）。前提：hU₁ : U₁ ⊆ dom(ϕ₂*ϕ₁)；L₁ ∈ lipSetOn d ϕ₁ U₁；L₂ ∈ lipSetOn d ϕ₂ (operator_image ϕ₁ U₁)，即精确中间像域 U₂ = ϕ₁(U₁)。结论 L₂ * L₁ ∈ lipSetOn d (ϕ₂*ϕ₁) U₁，乘积次序为 𝐋^{(2)}·𝐋^{(1)}。dom_mul_subset_right（U₁ ⊆ dom ϕ₁）与 image_subset_dom_of_subset_dom_mul（U₂ ⊆ dom ϕ₂）形式化了“由复合定义直接保证”。证明按原文顺序：先用 L₂ 的不等式，再乘非负系数代入 L₁ 的不等式，最后交换有限和。

declarations.name: LCH02.lip_comp
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem lip_comp (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ₁ ϕ₂ : Operator X bot) (U₁ : Set X)
    (hU₁ : U₁ ⊆ dom (ϕ₂ * ϕ₁)) (L₁ L₂ : Matrix I I ENNReal)
    (h₁ : L₁ ∈ lipSetOn d ϕ₁ U₁) (h₂ : L₂ ∈ lipSetOn d ϕ₂ (operator_image ϕ₁ U₁)) :
    L₂ * L₁ ∈ lipSetOn d (ϕ₂ * ϕ₁) U₁ := by
  refine ⟨hU₁, fun x hx y hy j => ?_⟩
  have hx' : ϕ₁.func x ∈ operator_image ϕ₁ U₁ := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hy' : ϕ₁.func y ∈ operator_image ϕ₁ U₁ := ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  calc d j ((ϕ₂ * ϕ₁).func x) ((ϕ₂ * ϕ₁).func y)
      = d j (ϕ₂.func (ϕ₁.func x)) (ϕ₂.func (ϕ₁.func y)) := rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ k, arrowEntry L₂ k j * d k (ϕ₁.func x) (ϕ₁.func y) := h₂.2 _ hx' _ hy' j
    _ ≤ ∑ k, arrowEntry L₂ k j * ∑ i, arrowEntry L₁ i k * d i x y := by
        gcongr with k
        exact h₁.2 x hx y hy k
    _ = ∑ i, arrowEntry (L₂ * L₁) i j * d i x y := by
        simp only [arrowEntry_mul, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, mul_assoc]
        exact Finset.sum_comm

declarations.name: LCH02.dom_mul_subset_right
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem dom_mul_subset_right (ϕ₂ ϕ₁ : Operator X bot) : dom (ϕ₂ * ϕ₁) ⊆ dom ϕ₁ := by
  intro x hx h
  apply hx
  change ϕ₂.func (ϕ₁.func x) = bot
  rw [h, ϕ₂.preserves_bot]

declarations.name: LCH02.image_subset_dom_of_subset_dom_mul

theorem image_subset_dom_of_subset_dom_mul {ϕ₂ ϕ₁ : Operator X bot} {U₁ : Set X}
    (hU₁ : U₁ ⊆ dom (ϕ₂ * ϕ₁)) : operator_image ϕ₁ U₁ ⊆ dom ϕ₂ := by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact hU₁ hx

declarations.name: LCH02.coLipSetOn_antitone

theorem coLipSetOn_antitone (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) {U V : Set X}

obligations.title: 输出零距且输入正距迫使对应co-Lip条目为0
obligations.reason: The designated positive-distance pair forces the selected co-Lip product to zero; ENNReal no-zero-divisor reasoning gives the coefficient zero.
obligations.candidate_representation: 前提：∃ x ∈ dom ϕ, ∃ y ∈ dom ϕ, d_j(ϕx,ϕy) = 0 ∧ 0 < d_i(x,y)。结论：∀ K ∈ coLipSetOn d ϕ (dom ϕ), K_{i→j} = 0（全域 co-Lip 矩阵即 𝒦(ϕ)|_{dom ϕ}）。证明：0 = d_j ≥ ∑_k K_{k→j} d_k ≥ K_{i→j} d_i，再由 ENNReal 无零因子以及 d_i > 0 推出 K_{i→j} = 0。

declarations.name: LCH02.coLip_entry_eq_zero
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem coLip_entry_eq_zero (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (i j : I)
    (h : ∃ x ∈ dom ϕ, ∃ y ∈ dom ϕ, d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = 0 ∧ 0 < d i x y) :
    ∀ K ∈ coLipSetOn d ϕ (dom ϕ), arrowEntry K i j = 0 := by
  rintro K ⟨-, -, hK⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hzero, hpos⟩ := h
  have hle : arrowEntry K i j * d i x y ≤ 0 :=
    calc arrowEntry K i j * d i x y
        ≤ ∑ k, arrowEntry K k j * d k x y :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => arrowEntry K k j * d k x y)
            (fun _ _ => zero_le _) (mem_univ i)
      _ ≤ d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) := hK x hx y hy j
      _ = 0 := hzero
  have hprod : arrowEntry K i j * d i x y = 0 := le_antisymm hle (zero_le _)
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with hK0 | hd0
  · exact hK0
  · exact absurd hd0 hpos.ne'

declarations.name: LCH02.coLip_comp
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem coLip_comp (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ₁ ϕ₂ : Operator X bot) (U₁ : Set X)
    (hU₁ : U₁ ⊆ dom (ϕ₂ * ϕ₁)) (K₁ K₂ : Matrix I I ENNReal)
    (h₁ : K₁ ∈ coLipSetOn d ϕ₁ U₁) (h₂ : K₂ ∈ coLipSetOn d ϕ₂ (operator_image ϕ₁ U₁)) :
    K₂ * K₁ ∈ coLipSetOn d (ϕ₂ * ϕ₁) U₁ := by
  refine ⟨h₁.1, hU₁, fun x hx y hy j => ?_⟩
  have hx' : ϕ₁.func x ∈ operator_image ϕ₁ U₁ := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hy' : ϕ₁.func y ∈ operator_image ϕ₁ U₁ := ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  calc ∑ i, arrowEntry (K₂ * K₁) i j * d i x y
      = ∑ k, arrowEntry K₂ k j * ∑ i, arrowEntry K₁ i k * d i x y := by
        simp only [arrowEntry_mul, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, mul_assoc]
        exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ ≤ ∑ k, arrowEntry K₂ k j * d k (ϕ₁.func x) (ϕ₁.func y) := by
        gcongr with k
        exact h₁.2.2 x hx y hy k
    _ ≤ d j (ϕ₂.func (ϕ₁.func x)) (ϕ₂.func (ϕ₁.func y)) := h₂.2.2 _ hx' _ hy' j
    _ = d j ((ϕ₂ * ϕ₁).func x) ((ϕ₂ * ϕ₁).func y) := rfl

obligations.reason: Negating the zero criterion yields an existential all-positive path. The n=1 empty intermediate sequence and single-entry criterion are included.
obligations.candidate_representation: 对任意 N 与 M : Fin (N+1) → Matrix I I ENNReal（即任意 n = N+1 ≥ 1 个扩展非负矩阵）及任意 i, j：0 < [M^{(n)}⋯M^{(1)}]_{i→j} ↔ ∃ p : Fin N → I, IsAllPositivePath M i j p，即存在至少一条中间指标序列，其所有单步条目严格正。n = 1 情形 finOrderedProd_entry_pos_iff_one 同时给出唯一空序列上的判据，以及它与 [M^{(1)}]_{i→j} > 0 的等价。证明经路径展开式 arrowEntry_finOrderedProd_eq_sum_paths（对 N 归纳、Fin.snocEquiv 重排求和），再由零值判据取否定得到。

declarations.name: LCH02.finOrderedProd_entry_pos_iff
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem finOrderedProd_entry_pos_iff {N : ℕ} (M : Fin (N + 1) → Matrix I I ENNReal)
    (i j : I) :
    0 < arrowEntry (finOrderedProd M) i j ↔ ∃ p : Fin N → I, IsAllPositivePath M i j p := by
  rw [pos_iff_ne_zero, Ne, finOrderedProd_entry_eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [HasZeroFactor, IsAllPositivePath, not_forall, not_exists, pos_iff_ne_zero, Ne]

declarations.name: LCH02.finOrderedProd_entry_pos_iff_one
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem finOrderedProd_entry_pos_iff_one (M : Fin 1 → Matrix I I ENNReal) (i j : I) :
    (0 < arrowEntry (finOrderedProd M) i j ↔ ∃ p : Fin 0 → I, IsAllPositivePath M i j p) ∧
      (0 < arrowEntry (finOrderedProd M) i j ↔ 0 < arrowEntry (M 0) i j) := by
  refine ⟨finOrderedProd_entry_pos_iff M i j, ?_⟩
  rw [finOrderedProd_one]

declarations.name: LCH02.arrowEntry_finOrderedProd_eq_sum_paths
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem arrowEntry_finOrderedProd_eq_sum_paths {N : ℕ} (M : Fin (N + 1) → Matrix I I ENNReal)
    (i j : I) :
    arrowEntry (finOrderedProd M) i j = ∑ p : Fin N → I, ∏ t, pathFactor M i j p t := by
  induction N generalizing j with
  | zero =>
    rw [finOrderedProd_one, Fintype.sum_unique, Fin.prod_univ_one, pathFactor_one]
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [finOrderedProd_succ, arrowEntry_mul]
    simp_rw [ih (fun m => M m.castSucc)]
    rw [← (Fin.snocEquiv (fun _ => I)).sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
    change _ = ∏ t, pathFactor M i j (Fin.snoc p k : Fin (N + 1) → I) t
    rw [mul_comm]
    conv_rhs => rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
    rw [pathFactor_snoc_last]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun t _ => (pathFactor_snoc_castSucc M i j k p t).symm

declarations.name: LCH02.lip_chain_certificate
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem lip_chain_certificate (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) {k : ℕ} (_hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (ϕ : Fin k → Operator X bot) (U₁ : Set X) (hU₁ : U₁ ⊆ dom (finOrderedProd ϕ))
    (L : Fin k → Matrix I I ENNReal)
    (hL : ∀ m : Fin k, L m ∈ lipSetOn d (ϕ m) (chainDomain ϕ U₁ m.castSucc)) :
    finOrderedProd L ∈ lipSetOn d (finOrderedProd ϕ) U₁ := by
  exact lip_chain_certificate_general d ϕ U₁ hU₁ L hL

declarations.name: LCH02.lip_chain_certificate_general
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem lip_chain_certificate_general (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) {k : ℕ}
    (ϕ : Fin k → Operator X bot) (U₁ : Set X) (hU₁ : U₁ ⊆ dom (finOrderedProd ϕ))
    (L : Fin k → Matrix I I ENNReal)
    (hL : ∀ m : Fin k, L m ∈ lipSetOn d (ϕ m) (chainDomain ϕ U₁ m.castSucc)) :
    finOrderedProd L ∈ lipSetOn d (finOrderedProd ϕ) U₁ := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact one_mem_lipSetOn_one d hU₁
  | succ k ih =>
    have hinit : U₁ ⊆ dom (finOrderedProd (fun i : Fin k => ϕ i.castSucc)) :=
      hU₁.trans (dom_mul_subset_right _ _)
    refine lip_comp d _ _ U₁ hU₁ _ _ ?_ ?_
    · refine ih (fun i => ϕ i.castSucc) hinit (fun i => L i.castSucc) fun m => ?_
      rw [chainDomain_init]
      exact hL m.castSucc
    · have h := hL (Fin.last k)
      rwa [← chainDomain_init, chainDomain_last] at h

obligations.candidate_representation: coLip_chain_certificate：前提 1 ≤ k、ϕ : Fin k → Operator X bot、U₁ ⊆ dom(c_k)，以及逐步证书 ∀ m, K m ∈ coLipSetOn d (ϕ m) (chainDomain ϕ U₁ m.castSucc)，即 𝐊^{(m)} ∈ 𝒦(ϕ_m)|_{U_m}（含每个 U_m 非空）。结论 finOrderedProd K ∈ coLipSetOn d (finOrderedProd ϕ) U₁，即 𝐊^{(k)}⋯𝐊^{(1)} ∈ 𝒦(c_k)|_{U₁}。k ≥ 1 在这里确实被使用：第 1 步证书给出 U₁ = U_1 非空。coLip_chain_certificate_of_nonempty 是在 U₁ 非空时对所有 k ≥ 0 的归纳形式：k = 0 用 P12，归纳步用两步 co-Lip 复合律（P08）。

declarations.name: LCH02.coLip_chain_certificate
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem coLip_chain_certificate (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (ϕ : Fin k → Operator X bot) (U₁ : Set X) (hU₁ : U₁ ⊆ dom (finOrderedProd ϕ))
    (K : Fin k → Matrix I I ENNReal)
    (hK : ∀ m : Fin k, K m ∈ coLipSetOn d (ϕ m) (chainDomain ϕ U₁ m.castSucc)) :
    finOrderedProd K ∈ coLipSetOn d (finOrderedProd ϕ) U₁ := by
  have hne : U₁.Nonempty := by
    have h := (hK ⟨0, hk⟩).1
    have h0 : (⟨0, hk⟩ : Fin k).castSucc = 0 := rfl
    rwa [h0, chainDomain_zero] at h
  exact coLip_chain_certificate_of_nonempty d ϕ U₁ hne hU₁ K hK

declarations.name: LCH02.coLip_chain_certificate_of_nonempty
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem coLip_chain_certificate_of_nonempty (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) {k : ℕ}
    (ϕ : Fin k → Operator X bot) (U₁ : Set X) (hne : U₁.Nonempty)
    (hU₁ : U₁ ⊆ dom (finOrderedProd ϕ))
    (K : Fin k → Matrix I I ENNReal)
    (hK : ∀ m : Fin k, K m ∈ coLipSetOn d (ϕ m) (chainDomain ϕ U₁ m.castSucc)) :
    finOrderedProd K ∈ coLipSetOn d (finOrderedProd ϕ) U₁ := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact one_mem_coLipSetOn_one d hne hU₁
  | succ k ih =>
    have hinit : U₁ ⊆ dom (finOrderedProd (fun i : Fin k => ϕ i.castSucc)) :=
      hU₁.trans (dom_mul_subset_right _ _)
    refine coLip_comp d _ _ U₁ hU₁ _ _ ?_ ?_
    · refine ih (fun i => ϕ i.castSucc) hinit (fun i => K i.castSucc) fun m => ?_
      rw [chainDomain_init]
      exact hK m.castSucc
    · have h := hK (Fin.last k)
      rwa [← chainDomain_init, chainDomain_last] at h

obligations.title: 任意有限非空矩阵乘积零值 iff 每条路径含零因子；含n=1
obligations.reason: A proved expansion sums all path products. Sum-zero iff all products zero and product-zero iff one factor zero give the criterion, including the singleton-matrix boundary.
obligations.candidate_representation: 对任意 N 与 M : Fin (N+1) → Matrix I I ENNReal（n = N+1 ≥ 1）及任意 i, j：[M^{(n)}⋯M^{(1)}]_{i→j} = 0 ↔ ∀ p : Fin N → I, HasZeroFactor M i j p，即每条中间指标序列上都存在某层 m 使 [M^{(m)}]_{k_{m−1}→k_m} = 0（k_0 = i, k_n = j）。n = 1 情形 finOrderedProd_entry_eq_zero_iff_one 同时给出唯一空序列上的判据，以及它与 [M^{(1)}]_{i→j} = 0 的等价。证明按原文：路径展开式 arrowEntry_finOrderedProd_eq_sum_paths 给出 ∑_p ∏_t 因子；非负项之和为 0 当且仅当每项为 0；ENNReal 中乘积为 0 当且仅当某因子为 0（含 0·∞ = 0）。

declarations.name: LCH02.finOrderedProd_entry_eq_zero_iff
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem finOrderedProd_entry_eq_zero_iff {N : ℕ} (M : Fin (N + 1) → Matrix I I ENNReal)
    (i j : I) :
    arrowEntry (finOrderedProd M) i j = 0 ↔ ∀ p : Fin N → I, HasZeroFactor M i j p := by
  rw [arrowEntry_finOrderedProd_eq_sum_paths, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [mem_univ, true_implies, HasZeroFactor, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff, true_and]

declarations.name: LCH02.finOrderedProd_entry_eq_zero_iff_one
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem finOrderedProd_entry_eq_zero_iff_one (M : Fin 1 → Matrix I I ENNReal) (i j : I) :
    (arrowEntry (finOrderedProd M) i j = 0 ↔ ∀ p : Fin 0 → I, HasZeroFactor M i j p) ∧
      (arrowEntry (finOrderedProd M) i j = 0 ↔ arrowEntry (M 0) i j = 0) := by
  refine ⟨finOrderedProd_entry_eq_zero_iff M i j, ?_⟩
  rw [finOrderedProd_one]

declarations.name: LCH02.arrowEntry_finOrderedProd_eq_sum_paths
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem arrowEntry_finOrderedProd_eq_sum_paths {N : ℕ} (M : Fin (N + 1) → Matrix I I ENNReal)
    (i j : I) :
    arrowEntry (finOrderedProd M) i j = ∑ p : Fin N → I, ∏ t, pathFactor M i j p t := by
  induction N generalizing j with
  | zero =>
    rw [finOrderedProd_one, Fintype.sum_unique, Fin.prod_univ_one, pathFactor_one]
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [finOrderedProd_succ, arrowEntry_mul]
    simp_rw [ih (fun m => M m.castSucc)]
    rw [← (Fin.snocEquiv (fun _ => I)).sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
    change _ = ∏ t, pathFactor M i j (Fin.snoc p k : Fin (N + 1) → I) t
    rw [mul_comm]
    conv_rhs => rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
    rw [pathFactor_snoc_last]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun t _ => (pathFactor_snoc_castSucc M i j k p t).symm

declarations.name: LCH02.pathFactor_snoc_castSucc
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem pathFactor_snoc_castSucc {N : ℕ} (M : Fin (N + 2) → Matrix I I ENNReal)
    (i j k : I) (p : Fin N → I) (t : Fin (N + 1)) :
    pathFactor M i j (Fin.snoc p k : Fin (N + 1) → I) t.castSucc =
      pathFactor (fun m : Fin (N + 1) => M m.castSucc) i k p t := by
  simp only [pathFactor]
  rw [Fin.succ_castSucc, indexPath_snoc_castSucc, indexPath_snoc_castSucc]

declarations.name: LCH02.pathFactor_snoc_last
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem pathFactor_snoc_last {N : ℕ} (M : Fin (N + 2) → Matrix I I ENNReal)
    (i j k : I) (p : Fin N → I) :
    pathFactor M i j (Fin.snoc p k : Fin (N + 1) → I) (Fin.last (N + 1)) =
      arrowEntry (M (Fin.last (N + 1))) k j := by
  simp only [pathFactor]
  rw [indexPath_snoc_castSucc, indexPath_last, Fin.succ_last, indexPath_last]

declarations.name: LCH02.indexPath_snoc_castSucc
declarations.source_excerpt:
theorem indexPath_snoc_castSucc (i j k : I) {N : ℕ} (p : Fin N → I) (u : Fin (N + 2)) :
    indexPath i j (Fin.snoc p k : Fin (N + 1) → I) u.castSucc = indexPath i k p u := by
  induction u using Fin.cases with
  | zero => simp
  | succ v =>
    rw [← Fin.succ_castSucc]
    simp [indexPath]
